content:
I am worried that after the release of Ogier: Oathbound all Absolute Axioms will be overtuned in the future releases of characters.  Ogier: Oathbound's current AA gives him +200% damage on sin stained spear, 400% STR bonus, and his defense cards are increased by 100%.  I have seen him output some seriously concerning damage numbers that can outclass any awakener in the game to my knowledge because of this AA.  In comparison to, say, Kathigu-Ra's AA that gives her final damage and strength effects of Fiamma by 30%...the difference is night and day.  I assume most AA's increase the characters effectiveness by 20 to 35% from what I have seen overall. Ogier: Oathbound's increases his effectiveness much higher than this threshold and I find that very concerning for the future releases of new characters. Are there any plans to tone done the future effectiveness of AA so our previous beloved awakeners can not be power crept at such an extreme rate? 

My largest concern over AA is that if they become this powerful or even more powerful, the difficulty for higher content will be overtuned for past awakeners that are cherished. Please consider my message. Thank you.
thread_title: My worries over the future of AA

content:
AA requires 16 copies. If you buy the silver prime directly, guaranteeing one copy is ~300 USD. If you only used free prototype horizons you will be waiting over a year, by which that character may very well have been power crept already. Making AA necessary for highest difficulties is not a healthy monetization model. People who are not already paying for AA  will not shell out that much money regularly because they don’t have that much money. They will just stop playing the game. This games competition, even in the same genre (Limbus) simply does not require that much monetary investment from players.

Yeah yeah I know “madness doesn’t have any major rewards” but dtide isn’t the only part of the worrying trend to monetize the game beyond what is reasonable for most people (ethereal cores, lack of buffs to powercrept characters, whale banners and  pre-order packages being offered more often, the MAIN STORY being a struggle without OE at later chapters)
thread_title: My worries over the future of AA
